name: Pyramid Party
summary: Pyramid Party is a first-person construction and resource-management game set in a stylized desert. Players start by digging sand by hand, process it into sandstone blocks, and place each block to build pyramids. Upgraded tools and drones help gather materials and transport supplies. Players manage water, upgrade the settlement, and defend their work from skeletons as day turns to night. The game can be played solo or in online co-op through Steam.
